record.title: Validate ARM64 thread inventory and gate the unchanged stock post-store capture
record.intent: Resolve the private observer ABI failure before drawing stock device-to-state conclusions.
requirements: Preserve the previous negative capture and test directory flags 0x10000 and 0x4000 in one explicit private comparison.
Record directory open and read return codes, bounded enumeration and status errors; reject incomplete inventories.
Require all private controls and inventories before stock observation.
Keep stock responses at offsets 0x4048 and 0x4044 with values 0xe1234567 and 0x89abcdef, and terminal PC 0x42a8f0 unchanged.
No further responses, stock artifact modifications, instruction stepping through synchronization or physical instrument access.
Capture enforcement and stable system_server evidence even when a private gate exits early; tear down the disposable guest.
acceptance: Independent verification classifies both directory flags and checks each successful inventory against its stopped private child.
Either stock post-store register/global evidence is independently verified or the exact next failed gate is preserved as a negative result.
Explicitly state main-thread supervision and non-atomic inventory limitations before any model expansion.
